# Barakaz

> Barakaz is a multi-vendor online marketplace based in Kenya, offering electronics, fashion, home & garden, health & beauty, and more from thousands of verified vendors with fast delivery across Kenya.

## About

Barakaz connects buyers with verified sellers across Kenya. Vendors can register and list products, while customers enjoy a curated shopping experience with secure checkout, M-Pesa and card payments, and reliable delivery.

## Key Features

- Multi-vendor marketplace with verified sellers
- Product categories: Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden, Health & Beauty, Sports, Phones & Tablets
- Secure authentication (email, Google OAuth)
- Shopping cart and checkout with M-Pesa, Visa, Mastercard, PayPal
- Order tracking and delivery across Kenya
- Vendor dashboard for product management, order fulfillment, and earnings
- Admin panel for platform management
- Multilingual support (English, Swahili)
